lines.zh: 我摇摆着走上沙滩，鳍肢一甩一甩。
lines.en: I waddle up the beach, flippers swinging.

lines.zh: 短腿迈不快，可我一步都不慌。
lines.en: My legs are short, yet I never rush a step.

lines.zh: 岸上走得笨，水里我像一支箭。
lines.en: Clumsy on land, but in water I am an arrow.

lines.zh: 我沿着海岸线，跟着同伴排队走。
lines.en: I follow my kin in line along the shoreline.

lines.zh: 一只接一只，我们晃过黑色礁石。
lines.en: One after another, we stagger past the black rocks.

lines.zh: 肚子迎着风，我慢慢挪向浅滩。
lines.en: Belly to the wind, I shuffle toward the shallows.

lines.zh: 别催，企鹅的步子是自己的节拍。
lines.en: Don't rush me; a penguin keeps its own beat.

lines.zh: 我用尾巴撑地，才站稳这道坡。
lines.en: I brace my tail to hold this slope.

lines.zh: 湿沙粘住脚蹼，每一步都更沉。
lines.en: Wet sand grips my feet and every step sinks deeper.

lines.zh: 我绕开水洼，免得溅自己一身。
lines.en: I skirt the puddle so I stay dry.

lines.zh: 古新世的海岸，我天天这样踱步。
lines.en: On this Paleogene shore I pace every day.

lines.zh: 浪一退，我赶紧横穿那片湿沙。
lines.en: A wave pulls back and I hurry across the wet sand.

lines.zh: 鳍肢张开当手，扶住这颗卵石。
lines.en: Flippers spread like hands, I steady on the pebble.

lines.zh: 我侧身挤过两只同伴之间。
lines.en: I squeeze sideways between two of my kin.

lines.zh: 风向变了，我转身换个方向走。
lines.en: The wind shifts, so I turn and walk another way.

lines.zh: 队伍拐弯，我也跟着拐过去。
lines.en: The column bends, and I bend with it.

lines.zh: 身后留下一排三趾的脚印。
lines.en: A row of three-toed prints trails behind me.

lines.zh: 天黑前，我得赶到那片避风的湾。
lines.en: Before dark I must reach that sheltered bay.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，任海风吹乱胸羽。
lines.en: I stand still as the sea wind ruffles my chest.

lines.zh: 眯起眼，我盯着水面发一会儿呆。
lines.en: Squinting, I stare at the water and drift off.

lines.zh: 像一根黑白的柱子，我立在岸边。
lines.en: Like a black-and-white post, I stand on the shore.

lines.zh: 我把一只脚收在腹下，暖一暖。
lines.en: I tuck one foot beneath me for warmth.

lines.zh: 喉咙里咕噜一声，算是叹气。
lines.en: A gurgle in my throat passes for a sigh.

lines.zh: 风把羽毛掀起来，我又压回去。
lines.en: The wind lifts my feathers; I press them flat.

lines.zh: 歪着头，我听浪拍礁石的节奏。
lines.en: Head tilted, I hear waves beating the rock.

lines.zh: 站着也是本事，我能站很久。
lines.en: Standing is a skill, and I can stand a long time.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，快跟礁石认不出了。
lines.en: I hold so still I nearly pass for rock.

lines.zh: 视线放远，我在等鱼群靠近。
lines.en: I look far out, waiting for the fish to come near.

lines.zh: 抖抖身子，把水珠甩掉一半。
lines.en: I shake and fling off half the droplets.

lines.zh: 日光落在背上，我安静地晒着。
lines.en: Sunlight rests on my back and I bask quietly.

lines.zh: 我打个哈欠，嘴张得能看见舌头。
lines.en: I yawn wide enough to show my tongue.

lines.zh: 海面这样平，我连头都懒得转。
lines.en: The sea is so calm I cannot be bothered to turn.

lines.zh: 我把脑袋转向你，先看你的手。
lines.en: I turn my head to you and check your hands first.

lines.zh: 你太高了，我得仰起脖子看你。
lines.en: You are so tall that I must crane my neck.

lines.zh: 我侧头打量你，像在认旧识。
lines.en: I eye you sideways, as if recalling a face.

lines.zh: 你身上没有鱼味，我有点失望。
lines.en: You carry no smell of fish, and I am let down.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，鳍肢不自觉地张了张。
lines.en: I fix on you and my flippers flare a little.

lines.zh: 你走近了，我把重心挪到后脚。
lines.en: As you near, I shift my weight to the back foot.

lines.zh: 我歪着脑袋，把你的影子看了又看。
lines.en: Head cocked, I study your shadow again and again.

lines.zh: 你这身打扮，不像是这片海岸的。
lines.en: Your gear does not belong on this coast.

lines.zh: 我咕地叫了一声，算是打招呼。
lines.en: I croak once, which counts as a greeting.

lines.zh: 隔着一小段距离，我谨慎地望你。
lines.en: From a small gap I watch you warily.

lines.zh: 疼！我缩起脖子往后退。
lines.en: Ouch! I pull my neck in and retreat.

lines.zh: 我尖叫一声，鳍肢乱拍。
lines.en: I shriek and flail my flippers.

lines.zh: 这一下打得我站都站不稳。
lines.en: That blow nearly knocks me off my feet.

lines.zh: 我护住肚子，踉跄着躲开。
lines.en: Guarding my belly, I stagger away.

lines.zh: 羽毛被打散了，我气得直叫。
lines.en: My feathers are mussed and I screech in anger.

lines.zh: 我疼得直蹬腿，沙都踢起来了。
lines.en: I kick in pain and spray up sand.

lines.zh: 又挨一下，这笔账我记住了。
lines.en: Another hit, and I will remember this one.

lines.zh: 我趴在地上，半天才爬起来。
lines.en: I lie flat a while before I manage to rise.

lines.zh: 血滴到脚蹼上，走路更滑了。
lines.en: Blood on my feet makes walking slippery.

lines.zh: 别打了，我不过是只企鹅。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; I am only a penguin.

lines.zh: 鱼腥味一飘来，我立刻站直了。
lines.en: The smell of fish snaps me upright.

lines.zh: 你手里那条鱼，我盯得眼都不眨。
lines.en: I stare at the fish in your hand without blinking.

lines.zh: 我摇摇摆摆凑过去，实在忍不住。
lines.en: I waddle over; I truly cannot help it.

lines.zh: 鳍肢拍着肚子，我在催你快给。
lines.en: Flippers slapping my belly, I urge you to hurry.

lines.zh: 我伸长脖子，喙尖朝着那条鱼。
lines.en: I stretch my neck, beak aimed at that fish.

lines.zh: 有鱼吃，走多远都值得。
lines.en: For fish, any distance is worth the walk.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，摆出讨食的姿势。
lines.en: I crouch low in a begging posture.

lines.zh: 喉咙里咕噜作响，那是馋的。
lines.en: My throat rumbles, and it is hunger.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的手转圈，眼睛不离鱼。
lines.en: I circle your hand, eyes locked on the fish.

lines.zh: 你把鱼抬高些，我也抬头去够。
lines.en: You raise the fish and I lift my head to reach.

lines.zh: 撞上我了！我踉跄着退两步。
lines.en: You bumped me! I stumble back two steps.

lines.zh: 我被挤得一歪，赶紧撑住地。
lines.en: Squeezed sideways, I brace myself on the ground.

lines.zh: 你这一下把我撞得转了个圈。
lines.en: That knock spun me clean around.

lines.zh: 我拍拍鳍肢，表示自己被吓到了。
lines.en: I clap my flippers to show I am startled.

lines.zh: 喂，走路看着点，我腿短躲不开。
lines.en: Watch where you go; my short legs can't dodge.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的腿滑开，差点摔倒。
lines.en: I slide along your leg and nearly topple.

lines.zh: 影子撞在一起，我先让了路。
lines.en: Our shadows collide, and I yield the way.

lines.zh: 我被顶得叫了一声，声音有点尖。
lines.en: The shove pulls a sharp little cry from me.

lines.zh: 站稳以后，我抬头瞪你一眼。
lines.en: Once steady, I glare up at you.

lines.zh: 这么挤，我只能侧身从你旁边过。
lines.en: So crowded, I must slip past you sideways.

lines.zh: 我们头靠着头，小声地互相叫。
lines.en: We press head to head and softly call.

lines.zh: 它替我把后颈的羽毛理顺了。
lines.en: It smooths the feathers at my nape.

lines.zh: 成对的企鹅，靠叫声认出彼此。
lines.en: Paired penguins know each other by voice.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，像两块黑白卵石。
lines.en: Side by side, we look like two black-and-white stones.

lines.zh: 我鞠一躬，它也鞠一躬，礼数周全。
lines.en: I bow, it bows, and we are properly polite.

lines.zh: 我们商量着，该在哪块石头后筑窝。
lines.en: We confer on which rock to nest behind.

lines.zh: 我轻轻碰它的喙，它没有躲开。
lines.en: I tap its beak lightly, and it does not flinch.

lines.zh: 我们轮流守着脚下这片地。
lines.en: We take turns guarding this patch of ground.

lines.zh: 它走开几步，我又把它叫回来。
lines.en: It wanders off a few steps; I call it back.

lines.zh: 两只企鹅一起晃，步伐居然一致。
lines.en: Two penguins waddle and somehow match pace.

lines.zh: 我低头叼起一颗光滑的石子。
lines.en: I dip down and pick up a smooth pebble.

lines.zh: 这枚卵石正合我意，我含着走。
lines.en: This pebble suits me, so I carry it along.

lines.zh: 我用喙拨了拨，把鱼叼稳。
lines.en: I nudge with my beak and secure the fish.

lines.zh: 我捡起一片海藻，甩掉上面的水。
lines.en: I pick up a bit of kelp and shake off the water.

lines.zh: 喙太小，大东西我可叼不动。
lines.en: My beak is small; I cannot hold anything big.

lines.zh: 我把石子放在脚边，再挑一颗。
lines.en: I set the pebble at my feet and choose another.

lines.zh: 叼着战利品，我得意地晃回窝。
lines.en: Prize in beak, I waddle proudly to the nest.

lines.zh: 有东西闪了一下，我啄了啄。
lines.en: Something glints and I give it a peck.

lines.zh: 我把它咽下去，喉咙鼓了一下。
lines.en: I swallow it, and my throat bulges once.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的，我都想捡来看看。
lines.en: Whatever falls, I want to pick it up and look.

lines.zh: 水里影子一闪，我立刻绷紧了。
lines.en: A shadow flicks in the water and I go taut.

lines.zh: 我锁定那条游鱼，头跟着它转。
lines.en: I lock on that fish and track it with my head.

lines.zh: 有什么在动，我先把身子压低。
lines.en: Something moves; I drop low first.

lines.zh: 盯住目标的一刻，鳍肢收拢了。
lines.en: The instant I fix the target, my flippers tuck in.

lines.zh: 是敌意吗？我还没分清，先戒备。
lines.en: Hostile? Not yet sure, but I stand guard.

lines.zh: 我把喙对准那团晃动的影子。
lines.en: I aim my beak at the wobbling shape.

lines.zh: 这声响不对劲，我转头去找。
lines.en: That sound is wrong; I turn to find it.

lines.zh: 我先看它的个头，再决定怕不怕。
lines.en: I check its size before deciding to fear it.

lines.zh: 目标一动，我的脖子就绷直了。
lines.en: The target moves, and my neck stiffens.

lines.zh: 锁定的一瞬，我听见自己的心跳。
lines.en: At the instant of locking on, I hear my heart.

lines.zh: 我跟着它挪步，始终保持着距离。
lines.en: I pace with it, always keeping my distance.

lines.zh: 眼睛不离开，它动我就动。
lines.en: My eyes never leave; when it moves, I move.

lines.zh: 它绕到右边，我立刻转向右。
lines.en: It circles right, and I turn right at once.

lines.zh: 紧盯之下，我的喙微微张着。
lines.en: Fixed on it, my beak hangs slightly open.

lines.zh: 我们隔着几步，谁都不先动。
lines.en: A few steps apart, neither moves first.

lines.zh: 我一直盯着它的脚，不看眼睛。
lines.en: I keep watching its feet, not its eyes.

lines.zh: 这姿势僵久了，腿有点酸。
lines.en: Held this way too long, my legs grow sore.

lines.zh: 只要它转身跑，我立刻追上去。
lines.en: The moment it turns to flee, I chase.

lines.zh: 我用喙猛啄过去，一下又一下。
lines.en: I jab with my beak, once and again.

lines.zh: 鳍肢抽在它身上，声音很脆。
lines.en: My flipper cracks against it, sharp and loud.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，全靠身体的重量压。
lines.en: I lunge in and press with my whole weight.

lines.zh: 短喙咬住不放，再把它甩开。
lines.en: My short beak clamps on before I shake it off.

lines.zh: 企鹅不软，我这一撞也不轻。
lines.en: Penguins are not soft, and this shove is no joke.

lines.zh: 我从侧面切进去，啄它的腿。
lines.en: I cut in from the side and peck its legs.

lines.zh: 它一退，我跟着又补一下。
lines.en: It backs off and I land one more hit.

lines.zh: 我低着头冲，脖子伸得老长。
lines.en: Head down and neck thrust out, I charge.

lines.zh: 打完，我喘着气退开半步。
lines.en: Fight done, I pant and step back half a pace.

lines.zh: 别以为我只会摇摇摆摆地走。
lines.en: Do not think waddling is all I can do.

lines.zh: 我从浪里冒出来，浑身滴着水。
lines.en: I surface from the surf, dripping all over.

lines.zh: 一片陌生的沙滩，我左右张望。
lines.en: An unfamiliar beach; I look both ways.

lines.zh: 被冲上岸，我先抖了抖羽毛。
lines.en: Washed ashore, I shake out my feathers first.

lines.zh: 这风的味道，像新西兰的海岸。
lines.en: The wind tastes like the coast of New Zealand.

lines.zh: 我从古新世的海里来，带着咸味。
lines.en: I come from Paleogene seas, still tasting of salt.

lines.zh: 一群同伴落在我身后，叫声嘈杂。
lines.en: A flock lands behind me, calling noisily.

lines.zh: 踩上干燥的沙，脚下有点发虚。
lines.en: I step onto dry sand and my footing feels odd.

lines.zh: 新地方，先找块礁石看看四周。
lines.en: New ground: first a rock to survey from.

lines.zh: 我甩甩尾羽，把沙粒抖下来。
lines.en: I flick my tail and shed the sand.

lines.zh: 天上没有海鸟，这地方有点怪。
lines.en: No seabirds overhead; this place is odd.

lines.zh: 我低头嗅了嗅地面，皱了皱喙。
lines.en: I sniff the ground and wrinkle my beak.

lines.zh: 落脚处得离水近些，我才安心。
lines.en: Wherever I settle, I need water close by.

lines.zh: 火苗舔到羽毛，我扑棱着打滚。
lines.en: Flames lick my feathers and I roll to smother them.

lines.zh: 落地时腿一软，我疼得叫出声。
lines.en: My legs give on landing and I cry out.

lines.zh: 水下喘不上气，我拼命往上游。
lines.en: Underwater I cannot breathe; I claw for the surface.

lines.zh: 巨响把我掀翻，耳朵嗡嗡作响。
lines.en: The blast flips me over, ears ringing.

lines.zh: 箭擦过我的背，羽毛飞了一片。
lines.en: An arrow grazes my back and feathers fly.

lines.zh: 一股怪力钻进骨头，我浑身发麻。
lines.en: Strange force seeps into my bones and I go numb.

lines.zh: 肚子空得太久，我站也站不住。
lines.en: Too long without food, I can barely stand.

lines.zh: 雷劈在身旁，我整只鸟都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes beside me and my whole body tingles.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地，我挥着鳍肢直往下坠。
lines.en: No ground beneath; flippers flailing, I fall.
